summary: Backend: 14/15 tests pass. Auth (register/login/me/logout), /api/players, /teams, /opponents, /player-info, /predict/bonus, /predict/compare, /predict/index all OK with correct shapes and no NaN/Infinity. /api/predict/top-by-role exceeds 5-min ingress timeout (502) in cloud env - works locally per backend logs but is too slow for production. Frontend: login page renders, but submit click did not redirect (likely tab vs submit ambiguity). Bonus/Compare/Index pages stuck on 'Caricamento…' indefinitely when not authenticated instead of redirecting to /login.

minor.issue: Hits 502 ingress timeout (>~300s). Iterates many players; needs caching or async/limit. Backend logs show it does compute results, just too slowly for the proxy timeout.

ui_bugs.issue: Stuck on 'Caricamento…' forever when user is not authenticated — no redirect to /login on 401 from /api/players. UX: either gate route by auth state or handle 401 by redirecting.

integration_issues.issue: Both the 'Accedi' tab and the 'Accedi' submit button share identical visible text. data-testid attributes are missing on tab/submit/email/password/form inputs, making automated testing fragile and possibly user-confusing for screen readers.
When axios call to /api/players returns 401 (no cookie), pages do not catch the error / redirect; spinner remains. Add interceptor or per-page error handling.

issues: Active tab and submit button use the same label 'Accedi' / 'Registrati' — slight visual differentiation only; consider renaming submit to a verb (e.g. 'Entra') and tabs to 'Login' / 'Registrazione'.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes on login/register inputs, tab buttons, submit buttons, navbar logout, page links, player select, predict buttons, and result cards.
Fix unauthenticated UX: in App.js intercept 401 (axios.interceptors.response) and redirect to /login or guard /bonus, /compare, /index with auth check before rendering.
Optimize /api/predict/top-by-role: precompute on startup, cache result with TTL, or move to a background job; current latency exceeds ingress proxy timeout (502).
Disambiguate login form: rename submit button label or add explicit data-testid to differentiate from tab control.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ML cache lazy-loaded on first request — first user pays heavy cost; consider warming in lifespan.
server.py: get_current_user catches jwt.InvalidTokenError, but ObjectId(payload['sub']) can raise InvalidId for malformed sub — wrap in try/except to return 401 instead of 500.
server.py: no rate limiting / login_attempts collection is created but never used — brute-force lockout (per playbook) is missing.
server.py: CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' when FRONTEND_URL unset; with allow_credentials=True browsers will reject. Ensure FRONTEND_URL is always set in env.
server.py exceeds ~470 lines — acceptable for now but split into routers/auth.py, routers/ml.py if it grows.
Frontend: missing data-testid coverage across all interactive elements (per requirement).

success_rate.frontend: 30% (login renders, but auth flow + 3 main pages not verifiable end-to-end due to 'Caricamento…' bug and tab/submit ambiguity)

test_credentials: admin@fantamodel.com / admin123 (verified working via API). Registered ephemeral users like test_<uuid>@example.com.
seed_data_creation: None beyond ephemeral test_*@example.com users created by register tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_fantamodel.py covers all backend endpoints; rerun after main agent adds rate limiting / fixes top-by-role perf. For frontend, after main agent adds data-testid attributes and a 401 redirect interceptor, retest: (1) login -> redirect /, (2) /bonus auto-fills team/opponent and returns metrics, (3) /compare radar, (4) /index multi-select & top-by-role tables, (5) logout. Note the login form has TWO buttons with text 'Accedi' (tab + submit) — must use data-testid to disambiguate.
rca of the issue: Frontend pages /bonus /compare /index display 'Caricamento…' indefinitely when unauthenticated because (a) routes are not wrapped in an auth guard and (b) the 401 from /api/players is not handled (no axios interceptor / no try-catch redirect). Reproduction: open /bonus in incognito -> spinner forever. Mitigation: add a <ProtectedRoute> wrapper that checks /api/auth/me and redirects to /login on 401, plus an axios response interceptor that redirects on any 401.
